record.rationale: React presentation and bounded scroll projection adapt native data through existing shared Writer browser controls without inventing native window or device services.
responsibilities: TaskRV75WR implements native1280twip compressed column widths,source FilterData hidden runs,geometry-only document copies,marked/grouped direct/show/hide commands and real ScUndoWidthOrHeight documents. ColumnWidth26290 uses typed UInt16 HMM and optional one-based FN_PARAM_1;the actual metric dialog normalizes two decimals in the configured CM/INCH unit,preserves default/current toggling,and records a separate completed even-HMM request. Shared SfxRequest now separates cloned SetReturnValue from Done and implements source call-mode flags/AppendItem/removal;both common dispatch adapters and the actual Writer style caller use that contract. React reuses shared Writer menus/dialog styling and reads actual native column geometry with bounded scrolling and hidden-column keyboard skipping. Independent ODS column style/repeat/visibility and genuine byte reopens preserve represented widths and cells. Full pool/recorder/UNO argument transforms,optimal widths,protection,merged/outline/drawing/alternate views,native widget/font/device services and complete application parity remain unverified. Existing primary saving/open/no-recovery policy remains.

stackDivergence.rationale: DOM/React own actual browser controls and physical scrolling;source document and numeric state remain with their canonical owners.
